description: Flexbox shorthand components for MUI Box and Grid, with x/y alignment, responsive props, and optional shared layout classes.
rules: Import from the adapter matching your MUI major version: @mui-flexy/v5, v6, v7, or v9.
Use FlexyProvider styling="classes" inside the matching MUI ThemeProvider for shared layout classes; system mode is the default.
Use size with FlexGrid in MUI v7/v9 or FlexGrid2 in v6; legacy FlexGrid in v5/v6 uses item and xs.
Run pnpm run demo for the public demo & docs; fixtures are isolated test applications, not the public demo.
